summary: MINISO Group Holding Limited filed a Form 6-K containing Hong Kong Exchange Next Day Disclosure Returns reporting on-market share repurchases for cancellation. Filings dated September 29-30 and October 1-2, 2026 show multiple buybacks, including 106,880 shares on September 28 at USD 2.2269 per share, equal to about 0.0088% of existing issued shares. Issued shares remained at 1,214,041,449 with zero treasury shares. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or closing condition is stated. Watch repurchase pace, aggregate capital returned, and potential support for the ADS/ordinary share price.
